hypothesis: One contract-aligned intervention selected by the C52-passing frozen dense value expert improves paired LIBERO success over candidate0 without repeated online distribution shift.
single_variable: At environment step80 only, control executes candidate0 for32 steps while the candidate selects one of four C52 seed offsets by frozen dense value; before step80 and after the chunk both use identical parent replan8 behavior.

gates.mechanical: exact step80 prestate, candidate0 action, seed offsets, frozen ranker identity and score variation
gates.effect: candidate >= control+2; >=3 paired wins; net wins>=2; no suite regresses by >1/5

decision.on_pass: Expand to the full LIBERO benchmark with a fixed sparse intervention schedule.
decision.on_fail: Reject online dense value selection; preserve C52 only as offline counterfactual evidence.
